QueueItem.description:
Represents a single item in the playback queue.

Attributes:
    id: Unique identifier for this queue item
    title: Song/video title
    url: Direct playback URL (resolved stream URL)
    source: Source type (ytsearch1, url, local)
    video_id: YouTube video ID (for thumbnails, metadata)
    artist: Artist/channel name
    resolved_at: Timestamp when URL was resolved (for freshness tracking)

artwork_url.description: Resolved artwork URL suitable for UI display
artwork_url.title: Artwork Url

capabilities.description: Provider capability overrides for this item (gapless, lyrics, bitrate, offline flags)
capabilities.title: Capabilities

media_type.description: Media type: 'audio' or 'video'. Determined by file extension for local files.
media_type.title: Media Type

playback_mode.description: Playback mode: 'qt_media' (local files), 'vlc_stream' (direct streams), 'external_browser', 'embedded_webview'. Determines which playback mechanism to use.
playback_mode.title: Playback Mode

provider.description: Normalized provider identifier (spotify, youtube_music, youtube_iframe, local, browser).
provider.title: Provider

resolved_at.description: Unix timestamp when URL was resolved
resolved_at.title: Resolved At

stream_token.description: Provider-issued token or track identifier required for official SDK playback
stream_token.title: Stream Token

unavailable.description: Whether this track is unavailable (e.g., provider not linked, disabled in build)
unavailable.title: Unavailable

unavailable_reason.description: Human-readable reason why track is unavailable
unavailable_reason.title: Unavailable Reason

QueueItem.title: QueueItem

description:
Complete player state representation.

This is the single source of truth for all player state.
Used by:
- MusicPlayer (internal state)
- WebSocket broadcasts
- UI updates
- API responses

Attributes:
    is_playing: Whether audio is currently playing
    now_playing: Currently playing track (None if idle)
    queue: Upcoming tracks in order
    volume: Current volume (0-100)
    position: Current playback position in seconds
    duration: Total track duration in seconds
    position_percentage: Position as percentage (0.0 to 1.0)

backend.description: Identifier for the active playback backend (e.g. 'vlc', 'simple', 'embedded', 'youtube_web').
backend.title: Backend

backend_capabilities.description: Backend-level capability flags (pause, seek, volume, etc.).
backend_capabilities.title: Backend Capabilities

backend_display_name.description: Human friendly backend name suitable for UI display.
backend_display_name.title: Backend Display Name

metadata.description: Additional state metadata for UI hints (playlist summary, context).
metadata.title: Metadata

playback_capabilities.description: Normalized capability flags after combining backend + track overrides.
playback_capabilities.title: Playback Capabilities

playback_errors.description: Recent playback warnings/errors surfaced to the UI.
playback_errors.title: Playback Errors

playback_mode.description: Current playback mode: 'vlc_stream' (for local files/direct streams), 'external_browser', 'embedded_webview'.
playback_mode.title: Playback Mode

resolver_info.description: Resolver metadata describing how the current track was resolved.
resolver_info.title: Resolver Info

state_version.description: Monotonically increasing version number for state changes. Incremented on each state update per PRD §4.2.
state_version.title: State Version

title: PlayerState
